title: Timing of Weight Bearing After Hallux Valgus Surgery
brief_summary: Investigate the optimal timing for weight bearing after Hallux Valgus surgery. Hypothesis: Early weight bearing does not affect outcome after the Endoscopic Distal Soft Tissue Procedure for Hallux Valgus Correction.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients undergoing the EDSTP recruited

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cases requiring additional procedures (eg 2nd toe correction)
* Mental incapacitation
* Physical disability hindering rehabilitation (eg CVA, neurological disorder)
